lines.en:
Sadira, there's an ATAC straight
ahead of us! Check your scanners!
lines.ru:
Садира, прямо по курсу АТАК!
Глянь на сканеры!

lines.en:
Are we being ambushed? Are they
friendly?!

Do we at least know what type of
ATAC it is?

Sorry, Sadira, but I don't recognize
its radar signature! We won't know
what it is 'til we see it!
lines.ru:
Прости, Садира, я не узнаю этот
сигнал! Пока не увидим, не
поймём!
